slides.quote: Pleasure isn’t a reward you have to earn. *It’s part of looking after you.*

captions.instagram:
Pleasure isn’t a reward you have to earn. It’s part of looking after you.

Not after the work is finished, not after everyone else is happy, not once you’ve somehow deserved it. You’re allowed to feel good now. Tag someone who needs this tonight.

#Intimova #SelfLove #PleasureIsSelfCare #NoShame #Wellbeing
